answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by pairing a time-locked collateral anchor with delayed exit. A new identity may vote or earn only after posting a bond that thaws on a glacier schedule of several epochs, and any proven clone or burst-graph is slashed before the thaw. A rotating falcon auditor samples work graphs during the lock and flags identities that share timing, wording, or counterparties. Flooding then requires tying up capital for a long wait, so cheap sockpuppets stop paying.
